magnitsky_act_advocacy.title: Using the Magnitsky Act to Freeze Their Assets

what_it_is.full_name: Justice for Victims of Corrupt Foreign Officials Act (Sergei Magnitsky Law)
what_it_is.passed: 2017 — pushed through by Freeland as Foreign Minister
what_it_is.applies_to: Gross and systematic human rights violations AND acts of significant corruption

magnitsky_act_advocacy.the_irony: Freeland pushed this law through to sanction foreign officials. The same law can be used to freeze assets of officials involved in the MAID program targeting vulnerable Canadians, the arms pipeline to Israel, procurement corruption ($140B+ in waste), and the suppression of whistleblowers.

how_to_use_it.step_1: Document gross human rights violations or significant corruption (this site contains 7M+ records doing exactly that)
how_to_use_it.step_2: File formal complaint with Global Affairs Canada requesting sanctions designation
how_to_use_it.step_3: Contact MP to raise in Parliament — the Act allows the Governor in Council to designate individuals
how_to_use_it.step_4: File with the International Criminal Court if domestic channels fail (Rome Statute Article 7)
how_to_use_it.step_5: Coordinate with international Magnitsky campaigns — the law exists in 35+ countries

potential_targets.note: Based on documented evidence on this site. All subjects entitled to due process.
